title: 第3章  初境功法
slug: 人在镇魔司红词加身只杀不渡
content_zh:
“打住，你失不失望关我屁事？我跟你很熟吗？”
“但凡你还要点逼脸，就闭上你的嘴！”
陆渊冷哼一声，大袖一甩，转身走入县衙。
穿过校场，步入后院，熟悉的朱漆大门就在眼前。
陆渊在云安县衙当了五年差役，闭着眼都能摸到正堂在哪儿。
大门虚掩着，里面隐约传来说话声。
一个低沉的男声说道：“云安县的苗子一如往年，看来没几个能通过选拔。”
另一个声音接着说道：“大人，有个叫林辰的后生倒是有几分底子，只是心性不稳。”
紧接着，县令那熟悉的声音响了起来。
“二位大人辛苦了，下官已备好薄酒，还请......”
砰砰砰！
陆渊抬手叩门，精准打断。
“进来。”
推门而入，正堂里坐着三道身影。
主座上是一个眉目威严的中年男人，身穿暗纹锦袍，织金大氅上绣有凶虎踏煞纹样。
他没有说话，单是坐在那里，就散发出一股令人心悸的冷冽气息。
下方两侧站着两个人，分别是镇魔司考官周通和云安县令。
考官周通抬眼看来，目光在陆渊身上扫了一眼，淡淡道：“你是何人？”
陆渊上前一步，抱拳行礼：“回大人，卑职陆渊，云安县差役，忠烈之后，前来领取直升腰牌。”
“忠烈之后？”周通眼神微动，看向县令。

县令连忙上前，对着主座上的男人拱手解释。
“大人容禀，陆渊之父陆远山，于十三年前蝠妖袭城时殉职，按规矩，此子的确是忠烈之后。”
“陆远山......”
主座上的那位大人低声念了一句，看向陆渊，眼底闪过一抹恍惚。
“今年多大？”
“回大人，刚过二十。”
“习武多久？”
“五年。”
“修为如何？”
“凡境二层。”
“......”
听到这里，一旁的周通下意识皱起眉头。
凡境二层，放在往年连报名的资格都没有。
虽说陆渊是忠烈之后，可镇魔司也不是什么人都能进的。
他微微摇头，内心已经有了决断。
只等主座上的那位大人开口，就将这不知天高地厚的年轻人轰出去。
却见主座之人沉默片刻，没有拒绝，而是从怀中拿出一本薄薄的册子。
“陆渊，这是一本初境功法，名为归元决。”
“想必你也知道，一入初境便是超凡脱俗，在这云安县也算是一方豪强，足以娶妻生子，安度余生。”
“你若是愿意，可用腰牌换此功法，比你进入镇魔司刀口舔血要好得多。”

陆渊愣住了。
周通也愣住了。
一旁的县令更是难以置信。
他的目光落在那本归元决上，眼珠子都差点儿瞪出来。
初境功法！
这可是打破凡境桎梏的天大机缘！
武道修行，凡境九重，练到头也不过是个功夫高强的凡人。
只有踏入初境，才算是真正踏上了修行之路。
可凡境到初境的这道坎，卡住了九成的武者。
想迈过这道坎儿，初境功法至关重要，这可是朝廷、宗门才有的秘宝。
就算黑市偶尔流出，也是上千两银子起步，就这还不一定能买到。
如此重宝，就这么随意送给一个素不相识的衙役？
县令张了张嘴，刚想说一句“大人三思”，可话到嘴边又咽了回去。
人家镇魔司做事，哪轮得到他一个县官插话？
陆渊看着那本归元决，眼底闪过一抹意外。
正如那位大人所说，在这云安县，一入初境便是一方豪强，足以安度余生。
与镇魔司刀口舔血相比，这是多少人梦寐以求的安稳。
他抬头看向那位大人，笑了一下。
不是讨好，也不是紧张，就像是想到了什么有意思的事。
“打小我爹就跟我说，一定不要以身犯险。”

“不过......我从没听过他的。”
“我要加入镇魔司。”
这话说完，正堂里静了一瞬。
还没等那位大人开口，一道不合时宜的声音就响了起来。
“还请大人三思！”
周通上前一步，沉声说道：“陆渊虽是忠烈之后，但镇魔司毕竟不是寻常衙门，不是那种靠着朝廷恩荫混吃等死的地方。”
他转身看向陆渊，语气冷漠。
“你以为镇魔司是什么？区区一个凡境二层，他日遇见妖魔，第一个死的就是你。”
“若是连你这样的资质都能入门，那些拼死拼活杀出来的年轻人，心里能服？”
陆渊淡淡一笑，目光直视对方。
“按大乾律，忠烈之后可直升镇魔司，这不是恩荫，而是我爹用命换来的。”
“若我真想混吃等死，何必要以身犯险？”
“我入镇魔司只是想斩杀妖魔，若他日真被妖魔所杀，那就是我命该如此。”
周通冷哼一声，看向主座抱拳拱手。
“大人，忠烈之后可直升镇魔司，只是对资质上佳者而言。”
“习武五年，凡境二层，说明他根本不是那块料。”
“若真让他入门，只会令镇魔司蒙羞。”
县令在一旁屏着呼吸，大气都不敢出。
主座之上，那位大人沉默片刻，最终做出决断。
“拿去吧，三日内前往青州镇魔司听用。”

陆渊伸手接过腰牌，只觉入手沉甸，触感冰凉。
低头一看，这腰牌通体由玄铁所铸，正面有云雷纹环绕“镇魔”二字，背面是一柄倒悬的横刀，贯穿于一方斩妖台之上。
“多谢大人！”
拿到腰牌，他不再多说，抱拳行礼，转身出门。
脚步声渐远，正堂重归安静。
周通在一旁憋了半天，终于忍不住开口问道：
“大人，那陆渊资质极差，即便进了镇魔司也撑不过入门考核，您何必要给他腰牌？”
主座之上，那位大人并未开口，只是望向门口的方向，眼底闪过一抹恍惚。
十三年前，蝠妖袭城，那是他升任镇魔卫之后的第一件差事。
本以为只是对付一只深山里窜出来的小妖，不料那只蝠妖比他想象的凶得多，一爪便将他拍飞出去。
他倒在巷子里，眼看着那只蝠妖扑来，尖利獠牙正对他的咽喉。
这时，一个穿着粗布短褐的县衙差役持刀冲来。
獠牙刺入那人脖颈，鲜血溢出，那人疼得浑身颤抖，却拼命将他挡在身后。
“走......快走......”
只来得及说出三个字，那人就被蝠妖吸干了血液，倒在地上如同一具干尸。
眼睛还睁着，望着天。
那双眼睛，和刚才那个叫陆渊的年轻人一模一样。
content_en:
"Stop it, it's none of my business whether you're disappointed or not? Do I know you very well?"
"If you want to show off, just shut your mouth!"
Lu Yuan snorted coldly, flicked his sleeves, turned around and walked into the county government office.
Walking through the school grounds and into the backyard, the familiar red painted gate is right in front of you.
Lu Yuan worked as a sergeant in Yun'an County Government for five years. He could feel where the main hall was with his eyes closed.
The door was ajar, and voices could be heard faintly inside.
A deep male voice said: "The seedlings in Yun'an County are the same as in previous years. It seems that not many can pass the selection."
Another voice continued: "Sir, there is a young man named Lin Chen who has some foundation, but his temperament is unstable."
Immediately afterwards, the familiar voice of the county magistrate rang.
"Thank you for your hard work, gentlemen. I have prepared some wine. Please..."
Bang bang bang!
Lu Yuan raised his hand and knocked on the door, interrupting accurately.
"Come in."
Pushing the door open, there were three figures sitting in the main hall.
Sitting on the main seat is a middle-aged man with majestic features, wearing a brocade robe with dark patterns and a gold-woven cloak embroidered with a fierce tiger treading pattern.
He didn't speak, and just sitting there gave off a chilly aura that was heart-stopping.
There were two people standing on both sides below, namely Zhou Tong, the examiner of the Demon Suppression Division, and Magistrate Yun'an.
Examiner Zhou Tong looked up, glanced at Lu Yuan, and said calmly: "Who are you?"
Lu Yuan took a step forward, clasped his fists and saluted: "My lord, Lu Yuan, who serves as a sergeant in Yun'an County and is a loyal and loyal soldier, comes to receive the promotion badge."
"Queen of loyalty?" Zhou Tong's eyes moved slightly and he looked at the county magistrate.
The county magistrate quickly stepped forward and explained to the man on the main seat.
"Your Majesty, Lu Yuan's father, Lu Yuanshan, died in the line of duty when the bat monster attacked the city thirteen years ago. According to the rules, this son is indeed a loyal queen."
"Lu Yuanshan..."
The adult on the main seat muttered something in a low voice and looked at Lu Yuan with a daze in his eyes.
"How old are you this year?"
"Sir, I'm just over twenty."
"How long do you practice martial arts?"
"Five years."
"How is your cultivation?"
"Second floor of the mortal realm."
"..."
Hearing this, Zhou Tong frowned subconsciously.
The second level of Mortal Realm would not even be eligible to register in previous years.
Although Lu Yuan is a loyal queen, not everyone can enter the Demon Suppressing Division.
He shook his head slightly, already making a decision in his heart.
Just waiting for the adult on the main seat to speak, he kicked out this ignorant young man.
However, the person in charge was silent for a moment, and instead of refusing, he took out a thin booklet from his arms.
"Lu Yuan, this is a first-level exercise called Guiyuan Jue."
"You must also know that once you enter the First Realm, you are extraordinary and extraordinary. In this Yun'an County, you are considered a powerful person, enough to marry a wife, have children, and live the rest of your life."
"If you are willing, you can exchange your waist card for this technique. It is much better than entering the Demon Suppressing Department to lick blood."
Lu Yuan was stunned.
Zhou Tong was also stunned.
The county magistrate on the side was even more unbelievable.
His eyes fell on the Guiyuan Jue, and his eyes almost popped out.
The first level of practice!
This is a great opportunity to break the shackles of the mortal realm!
In martial arts training, at the ninth level of the mortal realm, in the end, he will be nothing more than a mortal with high kung fu skills.
Only when you enter the first realm can you truly embark on the path of spiritual practice.
But the hurdle between the Mortal Realm and the First Realm has blocked 90% of the warriors.
If you want to get over this hurdle, the first level skills are crucial. This is a secret treasure that only the imperial court and sects have.
Even if the black market occasionally leaks out, it will only start with a thousand taels of silver, and it may not be possible to buy it.
Such a valuable treasure was given to an unknown government servant so casually?
The county magistrate opened his mouth and was about to say "Your Excellency, think twice", but he swallowed the words again.
When the Demon Suppressor is doing his job, in what turn will he be the county magistrate to intervene?
Lu Yuan looked at the Guiyuan Jue with a flash of surprise in his eyes.
As the gentleman said, in this Yun'an County, once you enter the first realm, you will be powerful enough to live the rest of your life.
Compared with the Demon Suppressor's knife-edge licking blood, this is the stability that many people dream of.
He looked up at the adult and smiled.
Not to please, not to be nervous, just like he thought of something interesting.
"My dad told me since I was little that I must never take risks."
"But...I've never heard of him."
"I want to join the Demon Suppression Division."
After saying this, the main hall was silent for a moment.
Before the adult could speak, an inappropriate voice rang out.
"My lord, please think twice!"
Zhou Tong took a step forward and said in a deep voice: "Although Lu Yuan is a loyal queen, the Demon-Suppressing Department is not an ordinary yamen after all, and it is not the kind of place where people wait to die relying on the favor of the court."
He turned to look at Lu Yuan with an indifferent tone.
"What do you think the Demon-Suppressing Division is? It's just a second-level mortal realm. If you encounter a demon in the future, you will be the first to die."
"If you can even get started with your qualifications, how can you be convinced by those young people who have worked so hard to get through?"
Lu Yuan smiled faintly and looked directly at the other person.
"According to the laws of the Qian Dynasty, those who are loyal and loyal can be directly promoted to the Demon Suppression Department. This is not a favor, but what my father paid for with his life."
"If I really want to eat and die, why should I risk my life?"
"I only wanted to kill demons when I entered the Demon Division. If I am really killed by demons in the future, that will be my fate."
Zhou Tong snorted coldly, looked at the chief seat and cupped his fists.
"Sir, those who have become loyal and loyal can be directly promoted to the Demon Suppressing Division, but only for those with good qualifications."
"Five years of practicing martial arts and reaching the second level of the mortal realm shows that he is not that material at all."
"If we really let him get started, it will only bring shame to the Demon Suppressor."
The county magistrate was holding his breath and did not dare to breathe.
On the main seat, the adult was silent for a moment and finally made a decision.
"Take it and go to Qingzhou Demon Suppression Division within three days to listen to it."
Lu Yuan stretched out his hand to take the waistband, feeling heavy and cold to the touch.
When he lowered his head and looked at it, he saw that the entire waist plate was made of dark iron. On the front, there were clouds and thunder patterns surrounding the word "Suppressing Demons". On the back, there was a horizontal sword hanging upside down, penetrating through a demon-slaying platform.
"Thank you, sir!"
After receiving the waist card, he said no more, clasped his fists in salute, and turned around to go out.
The footsteps faded away, and the main hall returned to silence.
Zhou Tong held it in for a long time, and finally couldn't help but ask:
"Sir, Lu Yuan's qualifications are extremely poor. Even if he entered the Demon Suppressing Division, he would not be able to pass the entrance examination. Why do you need to give him a badge?"
On the main seat, the adult did not speak, but looked in the direction of the door, with a daze in his eyes.
Thirteen years ago, the bat demon attacked the city, which was his first job after being promoted to the Demon Suppressing Guard.
He thought he was just dealing with a little demon that came out of the mountains, but unexpectedly, the bat demon was much more ferocious than he imagined, and it slapped him away with one claw.
He fell in the alley and saw the bat demon rushing toward him, its sharp fangs pointed at his throat.
At this time, a county government officer wearing coarse short brown cloth rushed in with a knife.
The fangs pierced the man's neck, and blood spilled out. The man was shaking in pain, but he tried his best to block him behind him.
"Go...go quickly..."
He only had time to say three words before the man's blood was sucked dry by the bat demon and he fell to the ground like a mummy.
His eyes were still open, looking at the sky.
Those eyes were exactly the same as that of the young man named Lu Yuan just now.
